# Data Profile

Record only aggregates and sanitized examples. Keep source extracts and protected values in an approved protected location, never in Git or prompts.

## Snapshot Identity

- Source revision or extract ID:
- Extract timestamp and time basis:
- Selection criteria and exclusions:
- Extractor identity and approval reference:
- Protected storage reference:

## Object Profile

For every in-scope object, record row count, key cardinality, duplicate keys, nulls, blanks, minimum/maximum length, numeric range and scale, code frequencies, invalid dates, encoding exceptions, orphan relationships, and control totals. Identify sampling limits.

## Anomalies

Give each anomaly an owner and disposition: cleanse at source, transform through an approved rule, quarantine as a reject, preserve intentionally, or block migration. Never silently truncate, coerce, default, or discard a value.
